about_the_game:
A co-op first-person action shooter for 1–4 players, where you battle endless waves of demons, undead, and monsters using an arsenal of weapons, magical abilities, and unique perks.

Each wave gets crazier. More enemies, tougher enemies, and less time to breathe. You’ll need to adapt fast, build on the fly, and constantly switch up tactics — or be crushed by the chaos of the oncoming darkness.

HELL IS COMING

Fight alone or shoulder to shoulder with up to four players in co-op. Every session turns up the heat — it’s not just about surviving, it’s about holding back the chaos: mix weapons with spells, pick perks, share ammo, and cover each other when things get wild.

KEY FEATURES

  • Hordes of enemies
    Endless waves of demons for you to mow down. The further you go — the thicker the meat.

  • A wide arsenal for every playstyle
    From classic shotguns to enchanted weapons. Mix and match combat styles to fit how you play.

  • Up to 4-player co-op
    Play online with friends. Share resources, save each other, and hold the line together.

  • Progression and perk system
    Create builds with unique perks. Adapt your playstyle and experiment with new ability combos.

  • Replayability and variety
    No two runs are the same thanks to randomized enemies, locations, and bonus effects.

NOTHING STOPS THE WAVE

This is a fast, intense game about holding your ground and adapting to chaos. There’s no promise of salvation — but you’ll get explosions, hordes, tactical carnage, and slow-mo-worthy moments.
Fight to the end. And bring extra ammo.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu® 18.04 LTS
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual core processor or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan API compatible video card with 2024 MB or more of memory supporting Pixel Shader 4.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: With surround sound support 5.1 or 7.1
  • Additional Notes: Supports the option launch Vulkan Graphical API
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu® 20.04 LTS
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Quad core processor or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan API compatible video card with 4048 MB or more of memory supporting Pixel Shader 4.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: With surround sound support 5.1 or 7.1
  • Additional Notes: Supports the option launch Vulkan Graphical API

short_description: Demonolition is a co-op shooter where you and your friends fight endless waves of demons. Kill enemies, earn cash, unlock weapons and perks, and explore new areas. The longer you survive, the crazier it gets. How long can you last against the monster onslaught?
